t: weirdly I can open a dm to myself, which then shows a dm history with someone else - perhaps that is my last active dm on x?

Correct read — that surfaced a bug in yesterday-s lookup ladder: a rows[0] fallback accepted fuzzy search-s top-ranked row even when it did not contain the handle/login; fuzzy subsequence over long snippets matches almost anything, and the top row is the most recent conversation — for a self-DM (your own name never appears in inbox rows, which show the counterparty) that bound your last active thread. Fixed: strict needle-substring matching only (the Use-the-thread-open-on-X escape hatch covers genuine misses), and self-DM is now a proper That-is-you state in both the Chat pane and the session-view DM popup (github-id compare via myIdentity threaded through). Deployed.
x: Chat.tsx strict match + self guard; DmPopup/SessionView/App myIdentity wiring; vitest; deploy
